title: 'Seitokai ni mo Ana wa Aru!' Reveals Additional Staff, Opening Theme, First Promo
content: The official website for the television anime adaptation of Maro Muchi 's Seitokai ni mo Ana wa Aru! ( There Is Also a Hole in the Student Organization! ) manga revealed additional staff, the opening theme, and first promotional video on Saturday. The anime series is scheduled to premiere on October 4 at 12.30 a.m.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Even the Student Council Has Its Holes! Anime Reveals Main Trailer and Opening Song, October 3 Premiere
content: The TV anime adaptation of Even the Student Council Has Its Holes! will premiere on October 3, 2026, with the first main trailer revealing the opening theme song. Its official English title is There Is Also a Hole in the Student Organization! The anime was announced in April 2025.
author: Anime Corner

title: Tokyopop Licenses 2 New Manhwa for 2027 Release
content: TOKYOPOP announced two new manhwa licenses at Anime NYC : Lily of the Valley and Magic Soup . Both titles are scheduled for release in 2027. Lily of the Valley and Magic Soup are part of a nine-title licensing lineup announced by the publisher, which also includes seven new manga titles.
author: ANN

title: Tokyopop Announces 7 New Manga Licenses Including Garagarapon
content: Tokyopop announced at Anime NYC on Friday it has licensed seven new manga. The company stated all the below titles are all scheduled for a release in 2027. The new licenses include: A peculiar roof-top amusement park. A stone monument by the mountain road. A 23 minute and 45 second film.
author: ANN

title: Fate/strange Fake TV Anime Confirms New Season
content: Aniplex confirmed in a video on Saturday that the Fate/strange Fake television anime will get a new season. The company first announced the news at a panel for the anime at the Anime NYC event on Friday.
author: ANN

title: 'Fate/strange Fake' New Season Announced
content: The Fate/strange Fake stage at Anime NYC 2026 announced that a new season is in production and revealed a teaser visual (pictured) on Friday. A-1 Pictures produced an anime special , subtitled as Whispers of Dawn aired in July 2023 at Anime Expo 2023, followed by the first season airing in Winter 2026.
author: MyAnimeList

title: 3 Reasons Solo Leveling Is Far Better Than Haters Give It Credit For
content: Even before the anime debuted in 2024, Solo Leveling was globally popular thanks to the exceptional story by Chugong. The light novel and the webtoon’s success made it possible for the anime adaptation to reach new heights of popularity.
author: ComicBook

title: Kodansha USA Licenses Trapped on Tape!, Announces Print Release for Hajime no Ippo: Fighting Spirit! Manga
content: Kodansha USA Publishing announced during its panel at Anime NYC on Friday new manga releases for its Kodansha Print Club as well as one horror license. The company also announced an omnibus print release for the long-running series Hajime no Ippo: Fighting Spirit!
author: ANN

title: Fate/strange Fake New Anime Season Announced With Teaser Visual
content: A new Fate/strange Fake anime series has officially been announced, with a teaser visual and the words “New Season Confirmed.” The announcement from the anime’s official account describes the project as a “new series,” while the newly released English-language visual specifically states “New Season Confirmed.” The…
author: Anime Corner

title: Omoi Licenses Love Is the Sweetest Journey Manga, Adds Titan Manga Titles
content: Digital manga publisher Omoi announced on Friday during its panel at Anime NYC that it has licensed Momoshiro and Tomoko Mitsuki's Love Is the Sweetest Journey ( Tabi wa Ui Mono Amai Mono ) manga, and will begin releasing English chapters in 2027.
author: ANN
